title: Siena no. 15: Mario Bandini at the imperial court, Innsbruck, 4 January 1547

steps.what: Project survey (siena1421): transcription of the P2/P6 runs (agents K, L) and the filed key R4764 compared by sign style; inconclusive, closed as too short.
George Lasry transcribed the cipher passages in CTTS (71 classes).
Crib guessing and dragging with Claude Opus 5.5 inside the clear context.
75 of 240 signs given a value; code words buf, abs, som, Za unidentified.
Report key figures of nos. 15, 17 and 5 compared sign by sign: different keys (Lambda is c here, e in no. 5; theta e here, z in no. 5; square-U n here, i in no. 17).

validation.notes: contributed reading: George Lasry's sign-level CTTS transcription and key are not in the repository, so no token alignment can be scored

outcome.method_basis: The report says the passages were partially deciphered by crib guessing and dragging with Claude Opus 5.5; no decipherment or matching filed key exists.

gaps.item: 165 of the 240 cipher signs on P2 and P6
gaps.detail: George Lasry's own partial reading; about 30 signs have no value and many readings are marked uncertain. Workable: the clear context is long and the transcription exists.

gaps.item: code words buf (3), abs (3), som (1), Za (1)
gaps.detail: No key in the busta gives them; R4764 inconclusive.

credits.note: Transcription in CTTS and partial decipherment with Claude Opus 5.5 by crib guessing and dragging (report pp. 28-30).
credits.source: Email and report to Daniel Bourdeau, 17 Oct 2026

prior.where: None known; the project's 24 Sept survey left it unread.

human: George Lasry transcribed in CTTS and deciphered part of the cipher with Claude Opus 5.5 by crib guessing and dragging; this project filed his report.
